metadata.title: Tropical forest productivity vulnerability (TFVI), 0.1-degree grid
metadata.description: Pan-tropical vulnerability index for gross primary productivity. Negative values indicate vulnerability toward decreases and positive values toward increases; values near zero indicate relative stability.
metadata.citation: Saatchi et al. (2021). Supporting scripts for 'Detecting Vulnerability of Humid Tropical Forests to Multiple Stressors'. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.5115158
metadata.study_time: GPP inputs span 1982-2018; the derived map has no embedded observation interval.

publications.title: Detecting vulnerability of humid tropical forests to multiple stressors

limitations: Standardized index; values are not probabilities, percentages or measurements of the response variable.
Results describe correlations and assume stable model relationships over time.
annotations.temporal_note: Catalog time is the source-file modification date, not the observation period.
annotations.processing: Lossless COG conversion; original grid, full-resolution values and mask preserved.

annotations.meaning: Tropical Forest Vulnerability Index for gross primary productivity

metadata.title: Amazon terrestrial ecosystem resistance
metadata.description: Relative resistance to terrestrial ecological connectivity across the Amazon basin. Higher scores indicate stronger barriers from human impacts and natural features. The supplied grid ranges from 1 to 34.
metadata.citation: Ritter, C. D. (2025). Amazon Basin data and code to replicate analyses. Version 1. Figshare. https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.28089815.v1
metadata.study_time: Input layers represent different dates, spanning 2001-2023; this is a composite resistance surface.

publications.title: Indigenous territories and protected areas are crucial for ecosystem connectivity in the Amazon basin

limitations: Relative resistance scores are not probabilities or measured movement rates.
The delivered grid starts at 1; values have not been shifted to the paper's conceptual zero-impact baseline.
annotations.temporal_note: Catalog time is a source-file modification date; the component dates are described in the linked evidence.
annotations.processing: Lossless COG conversion in native EPSG:5641; grid, values and mask preserved.

repository_metadata.title: Amazon Basin data and code to replicate analyses
repository_metadata.description: Spatial datasets and scripts used in the paper "Indigenous Territories and Protected Areas are crucial for ecosystem connectivity in the Amazon Basin" by Camila D. Ritter, Jesús Muñoz, Arielli F. Machado, James S. Albert, Camila C. Ribas, Ana C. Carnaval, Carmen Ulloa Ulloa, Juan D. Carrillo, Hanna Tuomisto, Dolors Armenteras, Juan M. Guayasamin, sent for publication to PNAS.

decisions: Choose the resistance-analysis copy; the grainscape package contains a byte-identical raster.
Retain native CRS and approximately279.61m cells; the filename does not imply an EPSG:4326 grid or native180m cells.
Preserve source scores unchanged; do not regenerate the ecological model or recompute impact coefficients.
limitations: Paper and script refer to multiple ecosystem resistance layers; only the matched terrestrial layer is admitted here.
Generating-code and publication descriptions differ in the baseline and some historical source-date labels. The supplied raster is preserved, and no silent reconciliation is applied.

metadata.title: Amazon tree density
metadata.description: Estimated trees per hectare across Amazon lowland forests on the published 0.1-degree grid, interpolated from inventory plots by forest type. The original grid is available for download; map display awaits CRS confirmation.
metadata.citation: ter Steege et al. (2023). Mapping density, diversity and species-richness of the Amazon tree flora. Version2. Figshare. https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.22786166.v2
metadata.study_time: April 2023 ATDN compilation; the underlying plot census dates vary and do not establish one map observation interval.

publications.title: Mapping density, diversity and species-richness of the Amazon tree flora

limitations: Based on old-growth forest plots and interpolated over the original lowland forest extent; this is not a current forest-cover inventory.
annotations.temporal_note: Catalog time is the source-file modification date, not a measurement date.
annotations.processing: Original ASCII grid preserved byte for byte; no spatial reference or geometry assigned.

annotations.tree_definition: Free-standing woody individuals with diameter at breast height at least 10 cm.

repository_metadata.title: Mapping density, diversity and species-richness of the Amazon tree flora
repository_metadata.description:
Files for "Mapping density, diversity and species-richness of the Amazon tree flora"

PlotData.csv: Plot metadata and diversity data, needed to run the R-scripts, plus references.

PlotsAbiotic.csv: Abiotic metadata for all plots, needed to run R-scripts

AmazonLowLandForestRaisg.csv: Coordinate file of Amazon forest (0.1 degree), withing Raisg boundary.

SoterRaisg.asc: Raster PlotsAbiotic.csv: Abiotic metadata for all plots, needed to run R-scripts

TreeDiversityFunctions.R: Functions need to run R-script

TreeDiversityScript.R: R-script to create all output

TreeDensity.asc: raster file of estimated tree density of Amazon forest

TreeDiversity.asc: raster file of fisher's alpha (0.1 degree) of Amazon forest

TreeRichness_ha.asc: raster file of species richness/ha (0.1 degree) of Amazon forest

TreeDiversityPoster01.tif: High resolution poster of tree diversity (Fisher's alpha) of Amazon forest

TreeDiversityPoster02.tif: High resolution poster of tree species richness/ha of Amazon forest
creators: Evlyn Márcia Moraes de Leão Novo

decisions: Keep the native spatial grid accessible through a geometry-null Item; nonspatial is catalog admission mode only.
No datum was inferred from coordinate ranges or software defaults.
The interpolated values describe the model surface; tree counts and species counts have not been rounded to integers.
limitations: Published article, deposited scripts and repository metadata did not provide an explicitCRS/datum. Degree-like coordinates establish neither WGS84 nor another datum.
The original script may rely on package-default geographic handling; that is not an explicit author-supplied datum declaration.
Supplement PDF retrieval was attempted viaPMC and publisher static-content URLs but was unavailable in this environment; supplementary figures were not used as CRS evidence.
review_context.next_step: Obtain an author or repository CRS statement and then losslessly encode the native grid as a GeoTIFF.

interpretation.population: Old-growth/undisturbed forest inventory plots; free-standing woody individuals with DBH >=10cm.
interpretation.map_scope: Interpolated attributes over the original lowland forest extent, not a current forest-cover map.
interpretation.richness_basis: Species richness per hectare uses Fisher alpha and trees per hectare to standardize plots of differing area.
